objective: Proof: for every knot K, with T(K) the number of transposition colourings, |Hom(pi1 S3_2(K), S4)| + |Hom(pi1 S3_4(K), S4)| = 8 + 3 T(K) and 3 |Hom(pi1 S3_2(K), S4)| + |Hom(pi1 S3_2(K # trefoil), S4)| = 16 + 12 T(K), using the peripheral identities of the B ticket and the meridian-class bookkeeping of integral surgery. With BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001A, counting homomorphisms to S4 is #P-hard (Turing, two queries per knot) for closed orientable 3-manifolds with first homology Z/2 given by integral surgery on knot diagrams, while abelian-by-nilpotent targets are polynomial there (BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001B). Standard-library checks by brute force over all S4 homomorphisms of the closed manifold groups.

title: S4 counting is #P-hard on closed manifolds with first homology Z/2
